derivation: from G3037 (λίθος) and a derivative of G4766 (στρώννυμι);
def: stone-strewed, i.e. a tessellated mosaic on which the Roman tribunal was placed

occurrences.text: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
